name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns ran and spent $42.10 for 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but brought in no leads.
points: Dedicated night runs accounted for all of the day's spend: $42.10, 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks and a 0.8% click rate. It brought no leads, so there is no cost per lead.
Regional Class A — Joliet spent $0.00 and showed no impressions or clicks, so it has no click rate and no cost per lead. Check whether it is meant to be running.
Spend so far in November 2026 is $42.10, all on Meta, with 28 days left in the month.

The week of 2026-09-28 had 40 leads. Of those, 20 were converted (50.0%), 12 applied and 5 were hired (12.5%). The week of 2026-09-21 had 38 leads, with 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied and 4 hired (10.5%).
The week of 2026-10-26 is too young to judge. So far it has 12 leads, with 9 contacted, 3 converted and 1 applied.
There are no lead-quality call results for any campaign over the last 14 days.
